reviews.review_title: Sky riders is with the big 3
reviews.review_description:
Sky riders just released and this game is so splendid!

This is just like how to train your dragon but on vr and more immersive and fun!

I had a lot of fun with my friend and even meeting some of the mods.

Even though there are a bunch of bugs it did just release but it’s up there with shark go and ug.

If you’ve ever wanted to know what it feels like to fly a mythical beast, this is it. The gameplay is incredibly smooth and the controls are super intuitive, making the flight mechanics feel completely natural and fluid. Flying through canyons and diving at full speed in VR is an absolute rush, and the sense of scale is breathtaking.

reviews.review_title: Seeing the world from the air is awesome
reviews.review_description: This game is amazing! Flying and exploring feels great, and there are lots of different kinds of enemies to defeat to earn gems! I want to keep leveling up to get a more powerful dragon! I love it!!!
Flying feels awesome and the game has a large map to explore. Throwing axes at enemies is so much fun!
